title: Why Excessive Thinking Destroys Your Health (1981-03-25)
description:
Do constant thoughts and future planning leave you drained? Discover the spiritual connection between your thinking habits, your liver, and dangerous modern diseases.

Shri Mataji explores the Swadhishthan (Sacral) Chakra, revealing how excessive thinking and rushing damage the liver and spleen, leading to issues like diabetes. She warns against the dangers of spiritism and mediums, answers deep seeker questions, and concludes with a guided self-realization experience.

Key Topics:
• 💭 Swadhishthan (Sacral Chakra) - how excessive thinking exhausts the liver and causes psychosomatic diseases like diabetes
• 🔬 The spiritual root of blood cancer - understanding the spleen as a "speedometer" overwhelmed by the frantic pace of modern life
• 🌙 The dangers of the left side - why consulting mediums and spirits leads to depression, possession, and loss of control
• 💬 Extensive Q&A covering reincarnation, the difference between awakening and realization, and why innocent children suffer
• ✨ Guided self-realization experience - awaken your Kundalini and feel the cool breeze of the Spirit on your palms

“Recognize yourself that you are the Spirit – not this body, not this mind, not this ego – but you are the Spirit.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• Is reincarnation necessary until the body gains true realization?
• Is there a difference between being awakened and realization?
• Is enlightenment a static process or a dynamic process?
• What is the difference between mind, consciousness, and Spirit?
• Why is the truth hidden despite so many prophets?
• Why does a child from a good home die of cancer at two years old?
• What happens if a chakra is damaged by a severe accident?
• Do you use different healing processes for different illnesses?
• Why do negative forces want to harm people?
• How should we protect ourselves?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• What causes diabetes and liver problems spiritually?
• How to stop overthinking and clear the mind?
• Symptoms of right side and left side imbalance?

Shri Mataji explains how the "speedy" nature of modern life damages the spleen. Have you noticed how rushing affects your inner peace and physical health?
